# Close task and hand off

Run the `close-task` skill. Inspect diff and Git status, run relevant tests, record exact results and limitations, and update affected `doc/` chapters, `doc/09-traceability/Feature-Code-Test-Matrix.md`, and `doc/10-open-items/Production-Gaps-and-Decision-Backlog.md`. Do not close findings without reproducible evidence. Do not claim commit/push/merge/deploy unless confirmed.
